title: Iligan college apologizes over alleged hijab ban on Muslim students
summary: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan Medical Center College (IMCC) has apologized amid backlash over allegations that Muslim nursing students were required to remove their hijabs during their capping ceremony…

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan Medical Center College (IMCC) has apologized amid backlash over allegations that Muslim nursing students were required to remove their hijabs during their capping ceremony and clinical duties. “It has never been the institution’s intention to cause hurt or make any member of its academic community feel excluded,” the college said in a statement on Monday. “Moving forward, the institution commits to reviewing and revising its existing uniform policy through multistakeholder consultations, taking into consideration religious and cultural practices, applicable laws, and relevant professional standards,” it added.
